questions: How many visits/day at full ramp?

samples.name: Health System Primary Care
samples.cons: Inbox burden, panel ramp, and quality metrics need detail.

samples.name: Private Primary Care Group

samples.name: Value-Based Care Clinic

Compensation: Is pay base guarantee, RVU, panel size, value-based care, quality bonus, or hybrid?
What is the wRVU threshold and conversion factor?
Are inbox/admin time, nursing home, hospital work, or call compensated?
Are Medicare wellness visits, chronic care management, and team-based work credited?
Are sign-on, retention, relocation, or loan repayment available?
Clinical model: What is expected panel size and visits/day at full ramp?
How many rooms, MAs, nurses, care managers, and scribes per clinician?
Who handles refills, forms, prior authorizations, portal messages, and results?
What percentage of schedule is same-day access, new patients, complex care, AWVs, or procedures?
APP supervision: How many APPs are on the care team?
Is supervision compensated by stipend, RVU credit, panel credit, percentage, or not at all?
Who signs charts, handles escalations, covers inbox, and owns liability?
Do APP visits affect my panel size, access metrics, or bonus?
Quality bonus: What metrics determine bonus: A1c, BP, cancer screening, AWV, vaccines, access, patient experience, risk coding, ED utilization, or total cost of care?
What is the maximum bonus and historical average payout?
Are targets individual, clinic-wide, or system-wide?
Are metrics adjusted for social risk, payer mix, staffing, and attribution?
Lifestyle / call: What is phone call frequency and nurse triage support?
Are weekends, nursing home, hospital, or home visits required?
How much inbox work occurs after hours?
Can schedule be 4-day week, part-time, or flexible?
Contract risk: What is the noncompete and does it restrict the whole primary-care market?
Who owns the panel if I leave?
Can productivity/quality formulas be changed unilaterally?
Are repayment obligations tied to sign-on, relocation, CME, or loan repayment?

Clinical Fit: Panel size, visits/day, access slots, complex care, and team support are realistic.
Compensation Upside: RVU, panel, value-based, quality, call, and inbox/admin credit are quantified.
Lifestyle Fit: Inbox, call, weekends, admin time, and schedule flexibility are manageable.
Risk Safety: Panel ownership, noncompete, tail, quality formula changes, and repayment are acceptable.
Strategic Fit: Clinic location, panel growth, value-based infrastructure, and leadership options build future value.
Collaborative Fit: MAs, nurses, APPs, behavioral health, care management, and specialists support care.
